scope: Measured wall-clock microseconds; estimated work is separately preserved in raw EXPLAIN and never converted to duration.
Reopen/recovery excluded from cold historical timers; disposable history cache empty, OS/page cache uncontrolled. Cold does not mean physical disk cold.
IPC, response serialization, result checksums and independent byte-for-byte model validation occur outside query timers.
Alternating version order; three repeat processes and every raw sample retained. Shared host, not dedicated hardware; performance misses remain published.
RSS is process-wide, including seeding, recovery, indexes, reference values and returned rows; no per-query allocations or hard RSS bound measured.
Replication uses real persisted three-Replica APIs and in-process FIFO delivery to all peers; no TCP, distributed hosts, failover, or quorum-only early-return throughput claim.
Targets use pooled p50 and nearest-rank p95; per-repeat distributions are also published; no baseline changes, selective exclusions or modeled samples.
